title: Spatially Gated Demographic Steering for Debiasing Multi-Person Text-to-Image Generation
title_zh: 面向多人文本到图像生成去偏见的空间门控人口属性引导

paragraphs.en: 提出空间门控引导SGS，无需微调即可在多人文生图中独立引导各人物属性以实现去偏见。 Text-to-Image models reproduce societal stereotypes, and existing mitigation applies one demographic correction to the whole scene. In multi-person scene generation this creates a trade-off: global steering improves aggregate balance only by homogenizing the people within an image. Steering-based methods like Embedding Arithmetic drive the intra-image diversity below the unsteered baseline. Text- and latent-projection approaches shift the aggregate skew with only marginal gains in intra-image diversity. We present Spatially Gated Steering (SGS), which steers the demographics of each person independently by extracting per-person masks from the Diffusion Transformer's (DiT) internal attention maps at a critical denoising timestep and applying a distinct demographic vector within each mask for the remaining steps. SGS needs no fine-tuning, inversion or layout specifications, and uses a lightweight segmentor over frozen DiT attention features to localize subjects at early timesteps. On skewed occupational prompts, SGS reaches high intra-image racial and gender diversity while keeping aggregate balance competitive and image quality near baseline, a result we validate on two architecturally distinct diffusion transformers, FLUX.1-Dev and SD3.5-Large. Codebase and model weights are available at https://github.com/cvims/spatially-gated-steering
paragraphs.zh: 提出空间门控引导（SGS），无需微调即可在多人文生图中独立引导各人物属性以实现去偏见。文生图模型会复制社会刻板印象，而现有的缓解方法只对整个场景施加一种人口属性修正。 在多人物场景生成中，这造成了一种权衡：全局引导只有通过使图像内的人物同质化才能改善总体平衡。 像嵌入算术（Embedding Arithmetic）这类基于引导的方法会使图像内多样性低于无引导的基线。 文本投影与隐空间投影方法能够偏移总体偏斜，但在图像内多样性上仅有边际提升。 我们提出空间门控引导（SGS），通过在关键去噪时间步从扩散Transformer（DiT）的内部注意力图中提取每个人物的掩码，并在其后的步骤中在每个掩码内应用不同的人口属性向量，从而独立引导每个人物的人口属性。 SGS 无需微调、反演或布局说明，它在冻结的 DiT 注意力特征上使用轻量级分割器，在早期时间步定位目标主体。 在存在偏斜的职业提示词上，SGS 实现了较高的图像内种族与性别多样性，同时保持具有竞争力的总体平衡以及接近基线的图像质量；我们在两个架构不同的扩散 Transformer——FLUX.1-Dev 和 SD3.5-Large——上验证了这一结果。 代码库与模型权重可在 https://github.com/cvims/spatially-gated-steering 获取。
